infrastructure.secret_management: environment variables and Vercel secret stores

verification.authorization: global proxy plus per-route trusted session and ADMIN checks
verification.session: opaque token; SHA-256 at rest; HttpOnly SameSite=Lax; Secure on Vercel; revocation verified
verification.llm: deterministic tool boundary, strict schemas, prompt-injection tests, escaped React rendering, no eval
verification.uploads: 10 MB limit, extension/MIME/signature checks, sanitized filename, private storage
verification.redaction: recursive persistence-boundary redaction and presentation re-redaction verified

filtered_candidates: Known demo credentials are an explicit acceptance requirement and are displayed only in demo mode.
Authentication throttling is absent, but rate-limit-only findings are excluded in daily mode and this is a one-user protected demo.
The production CSP permits unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval for framework compatibility; no executable user-controlled HTML or script sink was found.
No local gitleaks/secretlint policy exists; this is a hardening recommendation without a concrete exploit path.
